insight: Raised a $51M Series B led by IVP in late 2025 (~$89M total), expanding from month-end close into a broader finance platform.
name: Numeric
tagline: AI close-automation platform for accounting teams.
description: Numeric is an AI accounting platform that automates the month-end close — reconciliations, flux/variance analysis, cash matching, and financial reporting — for finance and controllership teams. It unifies close management, reporting, and cash workflows so complex accounting teams can close faster with less manual effort.
edge: AI-native month-end close — automating reconciliations, flux analysis, and cash matching (Brex's pilot reported a >90% auto-match rate).
pros: Unifies close, reporting, and cash workflows
Used by finance teams like Brex
Cuts manual effort for complex teams
